request.goal: I want to learn AWS from beginner to intermediate and focus on practical cloud fundamentals.

expected_behavior: Agent decomposes the topic, searches external resources through MCP, validates the roadmap, and saves a draft roadmap.

request.goal: I want to learn Docker from beginner to intermediate so I can containerize and run local projects confidently.

expected_behavior: Agent creates a dependency-aware Docker roadmap with lessons, at least one checkpoint, and real resource URLs.

request.goal: I want a practical Python roadmap that covers coding basics, tooling, and testing for small automation projects.

expected_behavior: A generated draft roadmap can be accepted and persisted as ACTIVE without changing its nodes.

request.goal: Generate a Docker roadmap where I can track progress lesson by lesson and unlock checkpoints automatically.

expected_behavior: Completing the first prerequisite lessons should unlock the first checkpoint through deterministic backend logic.

request.goal: I want a roadmap to learn Kubernetes foundations and core deployment workflows with persistent progress state.

expected_behavior: Roadmap data and progress remain available after reloading from persistence.
